identification: Box of about 12 mixed vintage books: George Robey 'After Dinner Stories' (illus. H.M. Bateman), 'Poetical Works of Adam Lindsay Gordon', Claude Berry (Cornwall/Cornish book, Robert Hale), 'Tahiti: Island of Love' (Langdon), Dawn MacLeod volume, 'Beautiful Scotland' painted by E.W. Haslehust (Blackie), 'Easy Steps / Men of Might' vols 1-2, a worn blue cloth volume, and Gregory's Melbourne Street Directory 14th ed 1982-83. A loose plate reads 'Lord Fisher'. Ordinary mid-20th century book lot.

viewing_check: Robey: confirm title page reads Grant Richards and the year (1922 = first); check for the ten Bateman plates. Gordon: read the title page imprint, an 1890s imprint or leather binding is worth more. Open the four blank spines (blue 2nd from left, pink 5th, navy worn 2nd from right, black flat item) and read the Fisher biography's title page. Tahiti: only a 1959 jacketed copy matters.
